chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created a people for the truth; so when the door of the truth passes by them, their hearts accept it, even if they do not know it. And when the door of falsehood passes by them, their hearts reject it, even if they do not know it. And He created a people for the opposite; so when the door of the truth passes by them, their hearts reject it, even if they do not know it, and when the door of falsehood passes by them, their hearts accept it, even if they do not know it.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between intellectual knowledge and heart acceptance of truth in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the concept of *fitrah* by distinguishing between those whose hearts are naturally attuned to truth and those predisposed to falsehood, emphasizing that spiritual receptivity often precedes intellectual comprehension. In Shia scholarship, this is frequently linked to the idea of *tawarrud* (natural inclination) and serves as a basis for understanding why some individuals accept the Imams or divine signs intuitively. It underscores that the heart's condition is a primary determinant of one's spiritual trajectory, independent of formal education.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Usman, from Ibn Azina, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Created a people for the truth. So when they pass by the door of the truth, their hearts accept it and even if it was so that they are not recognising it; and when they pass by the door of the falsehood, their hearts reject it and even though they are not recognising it. And He<sup>azwj</sup> Created a people for other than that. So whenever they pass by the door of the truth, their hearts reject it and even if they are not recognising it; and when they pass by the door of the falsehood, their hearts accept it, and even if they were not recognising it’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Uthman from ibn ‘Udhaynah from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, has created a people for the truth, when they pass by the door of the truth, their hearts accept it, even though they may not know it. When they pass by the door of falsehood, their hearts reject it, even though they may not know it. He has created a people for things other than this. When they pass by the door of the truth, their hearts reject it, even though they may not know it. When they pass by the door of falsehood, their hearts accept it, even though they may not know it.”
